protocol.counterbalancing: Baseline uses AB; dual-swap contains AB and BA. Comparison is matched by base-pair key.
protocol.eligibility: Exact human-reference pairs eligible for both frozen strategies.
exclusions: base pair absent from either condition
protocol.failure_handling: No data is NOT ESTIMABLE; failures and trade-offs remain visible.
protocol.hypothesis: The same base pairs permit a transparent baseline versus dual-swap trade-off comparison.
protocol.interpretation_limit: Mitigation is not successful by default; negative, null, and trade-off outcomes must remain visible.
protocol.primary_metric: Matched differences in agreement with Human Preference Reference Labels and paired position disagreement.
protocol.research_question: Can dual-pass mitigation reduce position sensitivity while maintaining human-preference agreement?
protocol.tie_handling: Ties are preserved in each strategy and metric denominator.
protocol.unit_definition: One base pair/judge/configuration represented under baseline and dual-swap strategy conditions.
